en: The image shows an illustrated autumn scene with stylized trees in vibrant shades of orange, yellow, and green. In the foreground, a woman in a blue dress and hat stands with a dog, facing a decorative wrought-iron gate. Beyond the gate, a large house or villa is visible on a hill. The illustration is highly decorative, suggestive of early 20th-century Art Nouveau style. The signature 'K. KRENK' is visible in the bottom right corner of the illustration.
